logos.name: SF 모노그램
logos.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create exactly ONE original polished logo concept for the Korean school student exercise habit service Self Fit. Brand meaning: personal progress, everyday movement, a friendly 12-week fitness challenge for teenagers. This is a logo exploration, not an app or website design.
Presentation: a single centered logo lockup on a clean pure white background, generous balanced whitespace, high resolution, square canvas. The mark and lettering should fill roughly the central 65% of the image. Crisp flat vector-like edges, professional optical balance, purposeful negative space. Show only one logo, no logo variations, no mockups, no cards, no borders, no stationery, no scene, no shadows, no textures, no 3D, no watermark, no slogans, no explanatory labels, no concept number. Readable at small sizes. Do not resemble an existing famous brand.
Existing product palette: emerald #1FAA73, deep emerald #0F7A50, charcoal #16181C, optional soft mint #CDEEDD. Use the concept-specific palette below. Typography must be intentionally designed and impeccably spelled.

Style: reductive geometric modern app identity. Build an ingenious compact SF monogram with a single bold emerald silhouette and carefully cut white negative space. Rounded exterior corners, a subtle forward step incorporated into the F, both S and F legible; minimal, memorable, not complicated interlocking. Place the monogram above a clean charcoal humanist rounded semibold wordmark. Text exactly: "Self Fit". Mark emerald #1FAA73, type charcoal. This should be the strongest timeless product-brand direction.
